rationale: The Rust lint foundation and canonical Oxfmt AST-in seam are proven, while the current lexical overlay is too fragile for an honest formatter claim. T016 therefore combines bounded scanner hardening with a user-visible native formatter for the real Markless-shaped @{ plus statement @if/@else subset. Collision-checked markers, one canonical Oxfmt parse, verified lift, atomic writes, ordinary-file bypass, and performance gates make this a coherent vertical. Complete TSRX grammar, Vite+, editor, packaging, config/plugins, upgrade lanes, and full Markless acceptance remain required.

worker_package.objective: Deliver the first production native formatter vertical: canonical Oxfmt formatting for ordinary JS/TS/JSX/TSX and for Markless-derived .tsrx containing @{ plus statement-position @if/@else, exposed through a Rust in-memory API and an oxfmt-like stdin/check/write/multi-file CLI. Harden lexical recognition for regex, template interpolation, JSX text/attributes, comments, decorators, Unicode, and marker collisions; reject all unsupported or ambiguous TSRX forms before writing; prove idempotence, source preservation, ordinary Oxfmt parity, fail-atomic behavior, and frozen P04/P05/P07 performance with red-first tests.
stop_if: Canonical Oxfmt drops, duplicates, reorders, or mutates collision-free markers such that checked lifting cannot preserve the supported syntax without private OXC APIs or a custom formatter fork.
Any supported fixture loses, duplicates, or reorders syntax, comments, Unicode, JSX text, or template content, or remains non-idempotent after two evidence-based corrections.
The supported path requires a second OXC parse, full AST conversion, whole-AST JS materialization, an OXC source patch/fork/copy, or a production JavaScript/Zig language core.
Release P04/P05/P07 exceeds a frozen threshold after two evidence-based native optimizations, or an ordinary standard-file path performs a TSRX scan/projection.
A required write is outside allowed_files or outside this repository.

missing_evidence: Installable platform packages and OXC upgrade lanes
required_board_updates: Create and activate T016 from worker_package; keep T999 queued.
